o: Mild steel reinforcement | माइल्ड स्टील सुदृढीकरण
e: Steel is a high-density material calculated by weight, with quintal (100 kg) being a common unit in estimates.

q: Which method of depreciation results in an equal amount of deduction every year? / मूल्यह्रास की कौन सी विधि हर साल समान कटौती का परिणाम देती है?
o: Straight Line Method | सीधी रेखा विधि
e: In the Straight Line Method, (Cost - Scrap Value) / Life gives a constant annual depreciation amount.

q: What is the 'Book Value' of a property after 10 years? / 10 वर्षों के बाद किसी संपत्ति का 'बुक वैल्यू' क्या है?
o: Original cost minus 10 years of depreciation | मूल लागत में से 10 साल का मूल्यह्रास घटाकर
e: Book value represents the current value of the asset as per the financial records of the owner.

q: The value of a building when it is sold by a bank to recover a loan is usually: / ऋण वसूली के लिए बैंक द्वारा बेचे जाने पर भवन का मूल्य आमतौर पर होता है:
e: Distress value is a forced sale price, often lower than the actual market value.

q: What is the 'Scrap Value' percentage of the total cost of construction normally taken as? / निर्माण की कुल लागत का 'स्क्रैप वैल्यू' प्रतिशत सामान्यतः कितना लिया जाता है?
e: A standard 10% of the original cost is often assumed as the scrap value for buildings.

q: Which factor most significantly increases the 'Market Value' of a residential plot? / कौन सा कारक आवासीय भूखंड के 'बाजार मूल्य' को सबसे महत्वपूर्ण रूप से बढ़ाता है?
o: Proximity to amenities (Market, Metro, Hospital) | सुविधाओं से निकटता
e: Location and access to infrastructure are the primary drivers of market value in real estate.

q: The 'Life' of a permanent R.C.C. building for valuation purposes is generally taken as: / मूल्यांकन के उद्देश्य से एक स्थायी R.C.C. भवन का 'जीवन' आम तौर पर लिया जाता है:
e: Well-constructed R.C.C. structures are expected to serve for about 80 to 100 years before needing major replacement.

q: What is the main advantage of the 'Sinking Fund Method' of depreciation? / मूल्यह्रास की 'सिंकिंग फंड विधि' का मुख्य लाभ क्या है?
o: It provides the actual cash to replace the asset at the end of its life | जीवन के अंत में संपत्ति बदलने के लिए नकद उपलब्ध कराना
e: This method ensures that by the time the building is useless, a fund (with interest) is ready to build a new one.

q: In valuation, 'Outgoings' do NOT include: / मूल्यांकन में, 'व्यय' (Outgoings) में शामिल नहीं है:
o: Capital cost of the building | भवन की पूंजीगत लागत
e: Outgoings are recurring annual expenses. Capital cost is the initial investment, not an outgoing expense.

q: The 'Year's Purchase' (Y.P.) is higher when the rate of interest is: / 'ईयर्स परचेज' (Y.P.) अधिक होता है जब ब्याज की दर होती है:
e: Y.P. = 100 / Rate of Interest. Therefore, Y.P. is inversely proportional to the interest rate.

q: A 'Freehold' property gives the owner: / एक 'फ्रीहोल्ड' संपत्ति मालिक को देती है:
o: Permanent ownership of land and building | भूमि और भवन का स्थायी स्वामित्व
e: Freehold ownership is absolute and has no fixed expiry date, unlike a leasehold.

q: What is the standard color of the pages in a physical Measurement Book (MB)? / एक भौतिक मापन पुस्तिका (MB) के पन्नों का मानक रंग क्या होता है?
e: Standard MBs usually have machine-numbered yellow pages to prevent tampering and ensure authenticity.

q: Which officer is primarily responsible for the 'First Check Measurement' of work recorded in an MB? / MB में दर्ज कार्य के 'प्रथम चेक मापन' के लिए मुख्य रूप से कौन सा अधिकारी जिम्मेदार है?
e: While the JE records measurements, the AE must perform a check measurement (usually 25% to 50%) to verify accuracy.

q: What should be done if a page in the Measurement Book is left blank by mistake? / यदि मापन पुस्तिका में कोई पन्ना गलती से खाली रह जाए तो क्या करना चाहिए?
o: Write 'Blank' and cancel it with a diagonal line | 'Blank' लिखकर तिरछी रेखा से काटें
e: Blank pages must be cancelled and signed by the recording officer to prevent any unauthorized entries later.

q: An 'Interim Bill' is paid to the contractor: / एक 'अंतरिम बिल' (Interim Bill) ठेकेदार को भुगतान किया जाता है:
o: During the progress of work | कार्य की प्रगति के दौरान
e: Interim bills (Running Account bills) help the contractor maintain cash flow while the project is ongoing.

q: In an NMR (Nominal Muster Roll), the 'Part-II' usually contains: / NMR के 'भाग-II' में आमतौर पर क्या होता है?
o: Unpaid wages details | अदत्त मजदूरी का विवरण
e: NMR Part-I is for attendance, while Part-II is used to record wages that were not paid during the normal disbursement.

q: The final payment to a contractor is made through which bill form? / ठेकेदार को अंतिम भुगतान किस बिल फॉर्म के माध्यम से किया जाता है?
e: White colored bill forms are generally used for the final settlement of accounts after completion.

q: What is 'First and Final Bill'? / 'प्रथम और अंतिम बिल' (First and Final Bill) क्या है?
o: Single payment for a small work after completion | छोटे कार्यों के लिए एक बार में किया गया पूर्ण भुगतान
e: For small works or supplies, no running bills are prepared; a single bill is made after the work is finished.

q: Who is the custodian of the 'Measurement Book' at the sub-divisional level? / उप-मंडल स्तर पर 'मापन पुस्तिका' का अभिरक्षक (Custodian) कौन होता है?
e: The SDO/AE is responsible for the safe custody and issuance of MBs in their jurisdiction.

q: The entries in an MB should be made in: / MB में प्रविष्टियाँ (Entries) किसमें की जानी चाहिए?
o: Ink or ball pen | स्याही या बॉल पेन
e: Entries must be permanent; pencil entries are strictly prohibited to avoid erasure or alteration.

q: The 'Register of Works' is used to keep a record of: / 'कार्यों का रजिस्टर' किसका रिकॉर्ड रखने के लिए उपयोग किया जाता है?
o: Expenditure on each individual work | प्रत्येक व्यक्तिगत कार्य पर होने वाला व्यय
e: It helps in monitoring the budget and total money spent against the sanctioned amount for a specific project.

q: Which method of depreciation is most suitable for heavy machinery that loses more value in the early years? / भारी मशीनरी के लिए मूल्यह्रास की कौन सी विधि सबसे उपयुक्त है?
o: Constant Percentage Method | निरंतर प्रतिशत विधि
e: This method (also called Reducing Balance Method) deducts a fixed percentage of the remaining book value every year.

q: What is 'Sinking Fund Method' of calculating depreciation? / मूल्यह्रास की गणना की 'सिंकिंग फंड विधि' क्या है?
o: Depreciation is equal to the annual sinking fund plus interest | वार्षिक सिंकिंग फंड प्लस ब्याज
e: In this method, the depreciation is considered equal to the amount set aside annually in a sinking fund.

q: The ratio of 'Net Income' to the 'Capitalized Value' is known as: / 'शुद्ध आय' और 'पूंजीकृत मूल्य' के अनुपात को कहा जाता है:
e: Years' Purchase is the capital sum required to be invested to receive an annuity of Re. 1 at a certain rate of interest.

q: What is 'Distress Value' of a property? / किसी संपत्ति का 'डिस्ट्रेस वैल्यू' (Distress Value) क्या है?
o: Value obtained when the property is sold hurriedly under pressure | दबाव में जल्दी बेचने पर प्राप्त मूल्य
e: Distress value is always lower than the market value as the seller is in urgent need of cash.

q: In valuation, 'Net Income' is calculated by: / मूल्यांकन में, 'शुद्ध आय' की गणना किसके द्वारा की जाती है?
o: Gross Income - Outgoings | सकल आय - व्यय
e: Outgoings include taxes, repairs, insurance, and management charges which are deducted from the total rent (Gross Income).

q: A 'Mortgage' is defined as: / 'बंधक' (Mortgage) को किस रूप में परिभाषित किया गया है?
o: Transfer of interest in specific immovable property as security for a loan | ऋण के लिए सुरक्षा के रूप में संपत्ति का हस्तांतरण
e: The owner (Mortgagor) gives rights to the lender (Mortgagee) as a guarantee to repay a debt.

q: What is 'Sentimental Value'? / 'भावनात्मक मूल्य' (Sentimental Value) क्या है?
o: Additional value an owner attaches due to personal attachment | व्यक्तिगत लगाव के कारण अतिरिक्त मूल्य
e: Sentimental value is subjective and usually ignored by professional valuers and banks.

q: The person who is granted a 'Lease' is called: / जिसे 'पट्टा' (Lease) दिया जाता है, वह कहलाता है:
e: The Lessor is the owner, and the Lessee is the person who uses the property for a fixed period.

q: Which factor primarily affects the 'Market Value' of a building? / कौन सा कारक मुख्य रूप से किसी भवन के 'बाजार मूल्य' को प्रभावित करता है?
e: Location is the most critical factor; a small flat in a city center can be more valuable than a mansion in a remote village.

q: A 'Leasehold Property' returns to the original owner after: / 'लीजहोल्ड संपत्ति' मूल मालिक के पास वापस आ जाती है:
o: The expiry of the lease period | लीज अवधि की समाप्ति के बाद
e: Once the lease term (e.g., 30, 60, or 99 years) ends, the property ownership reverts back to the lessor.

q: What is the full form of 'E-MB' in modern engineering departments? / आधुनिक इंजीनियरिंग विभागों में 'E-MB' का पूर्ण रूप क्या है?
o: Electronic Measurement Book | इलेक्ट्रॉनिक मेजरमेंट बुक
e: E-MB is the digital version of the traditional Measurement Book, used for recording work progress online.

q: Which type of payment is made to a contractor for work done but not yet measured in detail? / ठेकेदार को किए गए उस कार्य के लिए कौन सा भुगतान किया जाता है जिसका अभी तक विस्तार से मापन नहीं किया गया है?
e: Advance payment is usually a lump-sum amount paid for work done, which is later adjusted in the running account bill.

q: What is 'Secured Advance'? / 'सिक्योर्ड एडवांस' (Secured Advance) क्या है?
o: Advance paid on the security of materials brought to site | साइट पर लाए गए सामान की सुरक्षा पर दिया गया अग्रिम
e: It is an advance (usually 75% of value) given to the contractor for non-perishable materials brought to the site but not yet used.

q: A 'Voucher' is a document used for: / 'वाउचर' (Voucher) एक दस्तावेज़ है जिसका उपयोग किया जाता है:
o: Recording proof of payment or receipt of money | भुगतान या धन की प्राप्ति के प्रमाण के रूप में
e: Vouchers serve as legal evidence for any financial transaction in the accounts department.

q: The 'Retention Money' is deducted from: / 'रिटेंशन मनी' (Retention Money) किसमें से काटी जाती है?
o: Running Account Bills | रनिंग अकाउंट बिल (RA Bills)
e: Retention money is a percentage kept from every bill to act as a buffer for any defects found later.

q: What is 'Mobilization Advance'? / 'मोबिलाइजेशन एडवांस' (Mobilization Advance) क्या है?
o: Advance given to help contractor start the work | काम शुरू करने में मदद के लिए दिया गया अग्रिम
e: It is a loan-like advance provided to large-scale contractors to set up their plant and machinery at the start of a project.

q: The 'Cash Book' is maintained by: / 'कैश बुक' (Cash Book) किसके द्वारा बनाए रखी जाती है?
o: Disbursing Officer (e.g., Executive Engineer) | वितरण अधिकारी
e: The cash book records all daily receipts and payments of government money handled by the officer.

q: Which document is used for acknowledging the receipt of small payments for which no regular bill is prepared? / छोटे भुगतानों के लिए किस दस्तावेज़ का उपयोग किया जाता है जिनके लिए कोई नियमित बिल तैयार नहीं होता?
e: Hand receipts are used for petty payments like daily wages or small local purchases.

q: In 'E-payment' system, the money is transferred: / 'ई-पेमेंट' प्रणाली में, धन स्थानांतरित किया जाता है:
o: Directly to the contractor's bank account | सीधे ठेकेदार के बैंक खाते में
e: E-payment ensures transparency and speed in financial transactions by using NEFT/RTGS.

q: What is a 'Suspense Account'? / 'सस्पेंस अकाउंट' (Suspense Account) क्या है?
o: Temporary record of transactions that cannot be immediately classified | अस्थायी रिकॉर्ड
e: Items are kept in the suspense account until they are finally adjusted to a specific head of account.

q: How is 'Earnest Money' (EMD) different from 'Security Deposit' (SD)? / 'बयाना राशि' (EMD), 'सुरक्षा जमा' (SD) से कैसे भिन्न है?
o: EMD is paid after work starts
SD is returned immediately after bidding
EMD is for bidding, SD is for contract fulfillment | EMD बोली के लिए है, SD अनुबंध पूरा करने के लिए है
e: EMD is submitted with the tender to show sincerity, while SD is collected from the successful bidder to ensure quality and completion.

q: The amount of 'Security Deposit' is usually: / 'सुरक्षा जमा' (SD) की राशि आमतौर पर होती है:
e: SD is typically 10% of the contract value, which includes the EMD already deposited.

q: When is the 'Earnest Money' of unsuccessful bidders returned? / असफल बोलीदाताओं की 'बयाना राशि' कब वापस की जाती है?
o: Immediately after the tender is awarded to the lowest bidder | निविदा सबसे कम बोलीदाता को दिए जाने के तुरंत बाद
e: Once the contract is finalized with L1, the EMD of all other participants is refunded.

q: What is the 'Defect Liability Period'? / 'दोष दायित्व अवधि' (Defect Liability Period) क्या है?
o: Period after completion where the contractor must fix any defects | पूर्णता के बाद की अवधि जिसमें ठेकेदार को दोषों को ठीक करना होगा
e: Security deposit is usually released only after this period (usually 6 to 12 months) is over.

q: An 'Arbitrator' should ideally be: / एक 'मध्यस्थ' (Arbitrator) को आदर्श रूप से होना चाहिए:
o: A neutral third party expert | एक तटस्थ तीसरे पक्ष का विशेषज्ञ
e: An arbitrator must be impartial and knowledgeable about technical and legal aspects of construction contracts.

q: What is the advantage of 'Arbitration' over court litigation? / अदालत के मुकदमेबाजी की तुलना में 'मध्यस्थता' (Arbitration) का क्या लाभ है?
o: It is faster and less formal | यह तेज़ और कम औपचारिक है
It is done by the police
e: Arbitration avoids lengthy legal battles in courts, saving time and money for both the department and the contractor.

q: The 'Arbitration and Conciliation Act' currently in force in India was passed in: / भारत में वर्तमान में लागू 'मध्यस्थता और सुलह अधिनियम' कब पारित किया गया था?
e: The 1996 Act provides the legal framework for resolving disputes in commercial and construction contracts.

q: If a contractor fails to complete the work, the 'Security Deposit' can be: / यदि कोई ठेकेदार कार्य पूरा करने में विफल रहता है, तो 'सुरक्षा जमा' (SD) को:
o: Forfeited by the department | विभाग द्वारा जब्त किया जा सकता है
e: SD acts as a guarantee; if the contract is breached, the department uses this money to complete the work or cover losses.

q: What is an 'Arbitration Award'? / 'मध्यस्थता निर्णय' (Arbitration Award) क्या है?
o: The final decision of the arbitrator | मध्यस्थ का अंतिम निर्णय
A cash prize for the best contractor
e: The 'award' is the legally binding judgment passed by the arbitrator to settle the dispute.

q: Which document contains the detailed conditions of the agreement between the owner and contractor? / किस दस्तावेज़ में मालिक और ठेकेदार के बीच समझौते की विस्तृत शर्तें होती हैं?
e: The signed contract agreement is the legal document that defines the rights and duties of both parties.

q: What is the primary document that invites contractors to bid for a construction project? / निर्माण परियोजना के लिए ठेकेदारों को बोली लगाने हेतु आमंत्रित करने वाला प्राथमिक दस्तावेज़ क्या है?
o: Notice Inviting Tender (NIT) | निविदा आमंत्रण सूचना (NIT)
e: NIT is a public notice issued in newspapers or websites to invite qualified contractors to submit their bids.

q: Which type of tender is invited by sending notices only to selected reputed firms? / केवल चुनिंदा प्रतिष्ठित फर्मों को नोटिस भेजकर किस प्रकार की निविदा आमंत्रित की जाती है?
e: Limited tenders are used when the work is of a specialized nature or for small values where open competition is not necessary.

q: In which type of contract is the contractor paid the actual cost of construction plus a fixed percentage for profit? / किस प्रकार के अनुबंध में ठेकेदार को निर्माण की वास्तविक लागत और लाभ के लिए एक निश्चित प्रतिशत का भुगतान किया जाता है?
o: Cost Plus Percentage Contract | लागत प्लस प्रतिशत अनुबंध
e: This type of contract is suitable for emergency works where the scope is not defined, although it requires strict supervision of costs.

q: What is 'Corrigendum' in a tender process? / निविदा प्रक्रिया में 'शुद्धिपत्र' (Corrigendum) क्या है?
o: An amendment or correction to the original tender document | मूल निविदा दस्तावेज़ में संशोधन या सुधार
e: A corrigendum is issued after the NIT if any changes are made to the specifications, dates, or terms of the tender.

q: Which contract is most suitable for residential buildings where all items of work are clearly defined? / आवासीय भवनों के लिए कौन सा अनुबंध सबसे उपयुक्त है जहाँ कार्य के सभी मद स्पष्ट रूप से परिभाषित हैं?
o: Item Rate Contract | आइटम रेट अनुबंध
e: Item rate contracts (unit price contracts) ensure that the contractor is paid only for the actual quantity of work performed.

q: What is 'Comparative Statement' in tendering? / निविदा प्रक्रिया में 'तुलनात्मक विवरण' (Comparative Statement) क्या है?
o: A table comparing the rates of different bidders | विभिन्न बोलीदाताओं की दरों की तुलना करने वाली तालिका
e: After opening the bids, a comparative statement is prepared to find the lowest bidder (L1).

q: A 'Global Tender' is invited when: / 'ग्लोबल टेंडर' तब आमंत्रित किया जाता है जब:
o: High-tech equipment or large investment is required from international firms | अंतर्राष्ट्रीय फर्मों से उच्च तकनीक या बड़े निवेश की आवश्यकता हो
e: Global tenders allow international competition for very large-scale or complex infrastructure projects.

q: What is 'Administrative Approval'? / 'प्रशासनिक अनुमोदन' (Administrative Approval) क्या है?
o: Formal acceptance of the proposal by the department head | विभाग प्रमुख द्वारा प्रस्ताव की औपचारिक स्वीकृति
e: Administrative approval is the first step where the competent authority agrees to the necessity of the work.

q: In a 'Percentage Rate Contract', the contractor quotes: / 'प्रतिशत दर अनुबंध' में, ठेकेदार क्या कोट करता है?
o: Percentage above or below the department's estimated rates | विभाग की अनुमानित दरों से ऊपर या नीचे का प्रतिशत
e: The contractor either offers a percentage 'At Par', 'Above', or 'Below' the Schedule of Rates (SOR).

q: What is the validity period of a tender? / निविदा की वैधता अवधि (Validity Period) क्या है?
o: Period during which the contractor's offer remains open for acceptance | वह अवधि जिसके दौरान ठेकेदार का प्रस्ताव स्वीकृति के लिए खुला रहता है
e: Contractors cannot withdraw their bid during this period (usually 90-120 days) without forfeiting their EMD.

q: In Rate Analysis, the term 'Bhisti' refers to: / दर विश्लेषण में, 'भिश्ती' (Bhisti) शब्द का तात्पर्य है:
o: Water carrier for curing | क्योरिंग के लिए पानी ढोने वाला
e: A Bhisti is the laborer responsible for supplying water for mixing concrete/mortar and for curing the finished work.

q: How many standard bricks are required for 'One Cubic Meter' of brickwork? / 'एक घन मीटर' ईंट कार्य के लिए कितनी मानक ईंटों की आवश्यकता होती है?
e: Considering mortar joints, 500 modular bricks (19x9x9 cm) are required for 1 cubic meter of brickwork.

q: The volume of one bag of cement (50kg) is approximately: / सीमेंट की एक बोरी (50 किग्रा) का आयतन लगभग होता है:
e: This is a standard value (approx. 1.23 cubic feet) used to calculate the number of bags needed for concrete/mortar.

q: Which factor is NOT included in the 'Analysis of Rates'? / 'दरों के विश्लेषण' में कौन सा कारक शामिल नहीं है?
o: Personal insurance of contractor | ठेकेदार का व्यक्तिगत बीमा
e: Rate analysis focuses on direct project costs and overheads, not the personal financial liabilities of the contractor.

q: For '1:3:6' concrete mix, the digit '3' represents the proportion of: / '1:3:6' कंक्रीट मिक्स में, अंक '3' किसका अनुपात दर्शाता है?
e: The standard ratio format is Cement : Fine Aggregate : Coarse Aggregate.

q: The 'Dry Volume' of concrete is taken as how many times the wet (finished) volume for calculation? / गणना के लिए कंक्रीट का 'शुष्क आयतन' गीले आयतन का कितना गुना लिया जाता है?
e: When water is added, the volume of dry materials shrinks due to air voids being filled, so a factor of approx 1.54 is used.

q: In rate analysis, 'Sun-dry bricks' are usually cheaper because: / दर विश्लेषण में, 'धूप में सुखाए गए ईंट' आमतौर पर सस्ते होते हैं क्योंकि:
o: They do not require coal/wood for burning | उन्हें जलाने के लिए कोयले/लकड़ी की आवश्यकता नहीं होती
e: The cost of fuel for kilns is eliminated, though these bricks are only used for temporary or low-load structures.

q: What is the unit of 'Task Work' for a skilled carpenter in making a door frame? / दरवाजा फ्रेम बनाने में एक कुशल बढ़ई के लिए 'टास्क वर्क' की इकाई क्या है?
o: Cubic meter of wood | लकड़ी का घन मीटर
e: Labor productivity for woodwork is generally measured based on the volume of wood processed per day.

q: Which document gives the rates of various items of work as per the current market trends of a department? / कौन सा दस्तावेज़ किसी विभाग के वर्तमान बाजार रुझानों के अनुसार कार्य के विभिन्न मदों की दरें देता है?
o: Schedule of Rates (SOR) | दरों की अनुसूची (SOR)
e: The SOR (usually updated yearly) is the reference book used by engineers to prepare estimates.

q: For 'Plastering' work (12mm thick), the quantity of mortar is calculated for how much area? / 'प्लास्टरिंग' कार्य (12 मिमी मोटा) के लिए, मोर्टार की मात्रा कितने क्षेत्रफल के लिए गणना की जाती है?
e: It is a standard practice in rate analysis to calculate material requirements for 100 sqm of surface area.

q: While calculating the quantity of 'Earthwork in excavation', the deductions for internal corners in the Center Line Method is: / केंद्र रेखा विधि में खुदाई की मात्रा की गणना करते समय, आंतरिक कोनों के लिए कटौती होती है:
o: Half the thickness of the wall
e: In a simple rectangular center line, the extra length at outer corners is balanced by the deficit at inner corners, so no deduction is needed.

q: What is the deduction for 'T-junctions' in the Center Line Method of estimation? / अनुमान की केंद्र रेखा विधि में 'T-जंक्शन' के लिए क्या कटौती की जाती है?
o: Half the width of the wall | दीवार की चौड़ाई का आधा
e: At every T-junction, half the width of the wall is deducted from the total center line length to avoid double counting.

q: The measurement of 'Honeycombed brickwork' is usually done in: / 'हनीकॉम्ब ईंट कार्य' का मापन आमतौर पर किया जाता है:
e: Since honeycomb brickwork has many openings, it is measured as a surface area with specified thickness.

q: In a detailed estimate, deductions for openings (like windows/doors) in brickwork are NOT made if the area is less than: / विस्तृत अनुमान में, ईंट कार्य में छिद्रों (जैसे खिड़की/दरवाजे) के लिए कटौती नहीं की जाती है यदि क्षेत्रफल किससे कम है?
e: According to IS 1200, small openings up to 0.1 sqm are ignored in volume calculations for brickwork and plastering.

q: The unit of measurement for 'Woodwork for shutters' of doors and windows is: / दरवाजे और खिड़कियों के 'शटर' के लकड़ी के कार्य के मापन की इकाई है:
e: While frames (Chowkhats) are measured in cum, the shutters are measured based on the area of the opening in sqm.

q: Which of the following is measured in 'Running Meters' (rm)? / निम्नलिखित में से किसे 'रनिंग मीटर' (rm) में मापा जाता है?
e: Decorative items like cornices or pipes where length is the dominant dimension are measured in running meters.

q: The weight of one cubic meter of 'Mild Steel' is approximately: / एक घन मीटर 'माइल्ड स्टील' का वजन लगभग होता है:
e: The density of mild steel is 7850 kg/cum, which is crucial for calculating reinforcement quantities.

q: In 'Long Wall and Short Wall' method, the length of the long wall ________ from foundation to superstructure. / 'लंबी दीवार और छोटी दीवार' विधि में, लंबी दीवार की लंबाई नींव से सुपरस्ट्रक्चर तक ________ है।
e: As we move up from the wide foundation to the thinner wall, the length of the 'long wall' decreases (Out-to-out distance reduces).

q: The thickness of 'Plastering' is generally: / 'प्लास्टरिंग' की मोटाई आमतौर पर होती है:
o: 6 mm to 20 mm | 6 मिमी से 20 मिमी
e: Standard plastering for walls is usually 12mm, while ceiling plaster is 6mm to 10mm.

q: The measurement of 'Steel Trusses' is done in: / 'स्टील ट्रस' का मापन किया जाता है:
o: Kilogram or Quintal | किलोग्राम या क्विंटल
e: Structural steelwork like trusses and beams are estimated by weight after listing all members.

q: The value of a property at the end of its useful life, without being dismantled, is called: / उपयोगी जीवन के अंत में किसी संपत्ति का मूल्य, बिना तोड़े-फोड़े, कहलाता है:
e: Salvage value is the estimated value of an asset at the end of its life while still in working condition.

q: What is 'Depreciation'? / 'मूल्यह्रास' (Depreciation) क्या है?
o: Gradual decrease in the value of an asset due to wear and tear | टूट-फूट के कारण संपत्ति के मूल्य में धीरे-धीरे कमी
e: Depreciation accounts for the aging, usage, and obsolescence of a building or machine over time.

q: The value of a property shown in the account books after deducting depreciation is: / मूल्यह्रास घटाने के बाद खाता बहियों में दिखाई गई संपत्ति का मूल्य है:
e: Book Value = Original Cost - Accumulated Depreciation.

q: Which method of calculating depreciation assumes a constant rate of decrease in value? / मूल्यह्रास की गणना करने की कौन सी विधि मूल्य में कमी की एक स्थिर दर मानती है?
o: Straight Line Method | सीधी रेखा विधि
e: In the straight-line method, an equal amount of depreciation is deducted every year.

q: What is 'Scrap Value'? / 'स्क्रैप वैल्यू' (Scrap Value) क्या है?
o: Value of dismantled materials (junk) | तोड़े गए मलबे का मूल्य (जंक)
e: Scrap value is what you get after breaking down the asset into pieces (e.g., steel, bricks).

q: A fund created by setting aside an amount every year to replace an asset after its life is: / किसी संपत्ति के जीवन के बाद उसे बदलने के लिए हर साल एक राशि अलग रखकर बनाया गया फंड है:
e: A sinking fund ensures that enough capital is available to replace the structure once it becomes useless.

q: What is 'Obsolescence'? / 'अप्रचलन' (Obsolescence) क्या है?
o: Loss in value due to new inventions or change in fashion | नए आविष्कारों या फैशन में बदलाव के कारण मूल्य में हानि
e: An asset may become obsolete if a better technology comes along, even if it is still in good physical condition.

q: Which type of lease is for a long period, usually 99 years? / कौन सा पट्टा (Lease) लंबी अवधि, आमतौर पर 99 वर्ष के लिए होता है?
e: Long-term leases are common for land where the lessee builds a structure and returns it after the period.

q: The value of a property that can be obtained in the open market at any time is: / वह मूल्य जो किसी भी समय खुले बाजार में प्राप्त किया जा सकता है:
e: Market value depends on demand, supply, location, and the current economic situation.

q: A 'Freehold Property' is one where the owner: / 'फ्रीहोल्ड संपत्ति' वह है जहाँ मालिक:
o: Has absolute possession for life | जीवन भर के लिए पूर्ण अधिकार रखता है
e: In freehold, the owner has full rights over the land and the building forever, with no lease conditions.

q: What is 'Earnest Money Deposit' (EMD)? / 'बयाना जमा' (EMD) क्या है?
o: Security amount paid while submitting a tender | निविदा जमा करते समय भुगतान की गई सुरक्षा राशि
e: EMD is usually 1% to 2% of the estimated cost, taken to ensure the contractor is serious about the bid.

q: Which book is considered the 'original record' of all measurements of a construction work? / निर्माण कार्य के सभी मापों का 'मूल रिकॉर्ड' कौन सी पुस्तक मानी जाती है?
e: MB is the most important document for an engineer as it forms the basis for all payments to contractors.

q: A 'Lump-sum Contract' is one where: / 'एकमुश्त अनुबंध' (Lump-sum Contract) वह है जहाँ:
o: Payment is made for each item
Materials are provided by the department
Contractor agrees to do the whole work for a fixed total sum | ठेकेदार एक निश्चित कुल राशि के लिए पूरा काम करने के लिए सहमत होता है
e: In this contract, the contractor is paid a fixed amount for the entire project as per plans and specifications.

q: What is the purpose of 'Security Deposit' (SD)? / 'सुरक्षा जमा' (SD) का उद्देश्य क्या है?
o: To ensure the contractor fulfills the contract terms | यह सुनिश्चित करना कि ठेकेदार अनुबंध की शर्तों को पूरा करे
e: SD (usually 10% including EMD) is kept by the department to cover any losses or defects during the liability period.

q: The 'Nominal Muster Roll' (NMR) is used for: / 'नाममात्र मस्टर रोल' (NMR) का उपयोग किसके लिए किया जाता है?
o: Recording attendance and wages of daily labor | दैनिक श्रमिकों की उपस्थिति और मजदूरी दर्ज करना
e: NMR is the basic document for making payments to casual labor employed on a daily basis.

q: What is 'Arbitration'? / 'मध्यस्थता' (Arbitration) क्या है?
o: Settlement of disputes outside of court by a third party | तीसरे पक्ष द्वारा अदालत के बाहर विवादों का निपटारा
e: Arbitration is a legal process to resolve conflicts between the department and the contractor without going to court.

q: An 'Item Rate Contract' is also known as: / 'आइटम रेट अनुबंध' को इस नाम से भी जाना जाता है:
o: Unit price contract | यूनिट प्राइस अनुबंध
e: In this contract, the contractor quotes a rate for each individual item of work in the bill of quantities.

q: The 'Final Bill' is prepared only after: / 'अंतिम बिल' (Final Bill) तभी तैयार किया जाता है जब:
o: The work is completed and measured | कार्य पूरा हो जाए और मापा जाए
e: Final bill settling all accounts is made after the full completion of the project as per the measurement book.

q: What is 'Liquidated Damages'? / 'परिनिर्धारित हर्जाना' (Liquidated Damages) क्या है?
o: Compensation for delay in completing the work | काम पूरा करने में देरी के लिए मुआवजा
e: It is a penalty amount fixed in the contract to be recovered from the contractor if the work is not finished on time.

q: Which account form is used for a small amount given to an official for petty expenses? / छोटे खर्चों के लिए किसी अधिकारी को दी गई छोटी राशि के लिए किस खाता फॉर्म का उपयोग किया जाता है?
e: Imprest is a standing advance given to meet day-to-day office or site expenses.

q: What are the main factors affecting 'Rate Analysis'? / 'दर विश्लेषण' को प्रभावित करने वाले मुख्य कारक क्या हैं?
o: All of the above | उपरोक्त सभी
e: Rate analysis considers the current market price of materials, labor efficiency, transport, and overheads.

q: What is the standard 'Task Work' (output) of a mason for brickwork in cement mortar per day? / सीमेंट मोर्टार में ईंट कार्य के लिए एक राजमिस्त्री का प्रति दिन मानक 'टास्क वर्क' क्या है?
e: A skilled mason with helpers can usually complete around 1.25 cubic meters of brickwork in an 8-hour shift.

q: The 'Lead' in rate analysis refers to: / दर विश्लेषण में 'लीड' (Lead) का तात्पर्य है:
o: Horizontal distance of transport | परिवहन की क्षैतिज दूरी
e: Lead is the horizontal distance from the source of material to the construction site, usually measured in units of 30m or 500m.

q: How much 'Water Charges' are generally added to the estimate? / अनुमान में आम तौर पर कितना 'जल शुल्क' (Water Charges) जोड़ा जाता है?
e: Usually 1.5% of the total cost is allocated for providing water for construction and labor.

q: The measurement of 'Painting' on walls is done in: / दीवारों पर 'पेंटिंग' का मापन किसमें किया जाता है?
e: Painting, white-washing, and plastering are surface area works, hence measured in sqm.

q: Which of the following is NOT a unit of 'Labor' in rate analysis? / दर विश्लेषण में निम्नलिखित में से कौन 'श्रम' की इकाई नहीं है?
e: Labor is quantified in numbers of persons (mandays), whereas Kilogram is a unit of weight for materials.

q: For 10 cubic meters of R.C.C. (1:2:4) work, the approximate quantity of cement required is: / 10 घन मीटर R.C.C. (1:2:4) कार्य के लिए आवश्यक सीमेंट की अनुमानित मात्रा है:
e: Based on dry volume calculation (1.52 to 1.54 times wet volume), R.C.C. 1:2:4 requires approx 6.4 bags per cum.

q: What is 'Lift' in construction work? / निर्माण कार्य में 'लिफ्ट' (Lift) क्या है?
o: Vertical distance of transport | परिवहन की ऊर्ध्वाधर दूरी
e: Lift is the vertical distance through which excavated soil or material is moved, usually measured in units of 1.5m.

q: The measurement of 'Woodwork for door frames' is done in: / 'दरवाजे के फ्रेम' (चौखट) के लकड़ी के कार्य का मापन किया जाता है:
e: Door and window frames (Chowkhats) are measured by volume, while shutters are measured by area (sqm).

q: In rate analysis, 'Overhead Charges' include: / दर विश्लेषण में, 'ओवरहेड शुल्क' (Overhead Charges) में शामिल हैं:
o: Office rent and staff salary | कार्यालय किराया और स्टाफ वेतन
e: Overheads are indirect costs like office expenses, taxes, and supervision charges.

q: Which type of estimate is carried out to get an approximate cost in a short time before the detailed design? / विस्तृत डिजाइन से पहले कम समय में अनुमानित लागत प्राप्त करने के लिए किस प्रकार का अनुमान लगाया जाता है?
e: A preliminary or approximate estimate is used for administrative approval and to decide the feasibility of a project.

q: The unit of measurement for 'Earthwork in excavation' is: / 'खुदाई के कार्य' (Earthwork) के मापन की इकाई क्या है?
e: Earthwork excavation involves volume calculation (Length x Breadth x Depth), hence measured in cubic meters.

q: What is 'Contingencies' in an estimate? / एक अनुमान में 'आकस्मिक व्यय' (Contingencies) क्या है?
o: Amount for unforeseen small items | अप्रत्याशित मदों के लिए राशि
e: Usually 3% to 5% of the total estimate is kept for miscellaneous petty items that cannot be classified specifically.

q: The measurement of 'Damp Proof Course' (DPC) is done in: / 'डैम्प प्रूफ कोर्स' (DPC) का मापन किसमें किया जाता है?
e: DPC is a thin layer where thickness is specified, so the measurement is based on the area covered.

q: Which method of building estimate is more accurate for quantity calculation? / परिमाण गणना के लिए भवन अनुमान की कौन सी विधि अधिक सटीक है?
o: Long wall and short wall method | लंबी दीवार और छोटी दीवार विधि
Both A and B | A और B दोनों
Center line method | केंद्र रेखा विधि
e: Both center line and long-short wall methods provide accurate results if applied correctly, though center line is faster for symmetrical buildings.

q: In a detailed estimate, 'Brickwork' in the superstructure is measured in: / एक विस्तृत अनुमान में, सुपरस्ट्रक्चर में 'ईंट का काम' मापा जाता है:
e: Standard brickwork (more than half-brick thick) is always measured by volume in cum.

q: What is the percentage added for 'Contractor's Profit' in a general estimate? / सामान्य अनुमान में 'ठेकेदार के लाभ' के लिए कितना प्रतिशत जोड़ा जाता है?
e: A standard 10% is usually added to the total cost of materials and labor as contractor's profit.

q: The 'Plinth Area' of a building does not include: / किसी भवन के 'प्लिंथ क्षेत्र' में शामिल नहीं है:
e: Plinth area is the built-up covered area; open spaces like courtyards are excluded.

q: A 'Revised Estimate' is prepared when the original sanctioned estimate is likely to exceed by more than: / एक 'संशोधित अनुमान' तब तैयार किया जाता है जब मूल स्वीकृत अनुमान के कितने से अधिक होने की संभावना हो?
e: If the cost increases by more than 5% due to price hike or other reasons, a revised estimate is mandatory.

q: The unit of measurement for 'Reinforcement steel' in R.C.C. work is: / R.C.C. कार्य में 'सुदृढीकरण स्टील' (सरिया) के मापन की इकाई है:
o: Quintal or Tonne | क्विंटल या टन
e: Steel is always calculated by weight (kg, quintal, or tonne) after calculating the total length and weight per unit length.

q: Temporary hardness of water can be removed by: / जल की अस्थायी कठोरता को किसके द्वारा दूर किया जा सकता है?
e: Boiling decomposes calcium and magnesium bicarbonates into insoluble carbonates.

q: Which of the following is a 'Thermosetting' plastic? / निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा एक 'थर्मोसेटिंग' प्लास्टिक है?
e: Bakelite does not soften on heating once it is molded, unlike thermoplastics.

q: What is the chemical composition of 'LPG'? / 'LPG' का रासायनिक संगठन क्या है?
o: Propane and Butane | प्रोपेन और ब्यूटेन
e: LPG (Liquefied Petroleum Gas) is primarily a mixture of propane and butane gases.

q: The property of a lubricant to resist flow is known as: / एक स्नेहक (Lubricant) के प्रवाह का विरोध करने के गुण को कहा जाता है:
